name: Test Script
script:
if frappe.form_dict:
    po_doc = frappe.get_doc("Test PO", frappe.form_dict.doc_name)
    
    pr_data = {
        "doctype": "Test PR",
        "supplier": po_doc.supplier,
        "currency": po_doc.currency,
        "price_list": po_doc.price_list,
        "items": [],
        "test_po": po_doc.name
    }
    
    # Using IFNULL in SQL to ensure qty is never None
    already_received_qty = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT item, IFNULL(SUM(qty), 0) as qty, po_row_name
        FROM `tabTest PR Items`
        WHERE test_po = %s AND docstatus = 1 
        GROUP BY po_row_name
    """, (po_doc.name,), as_dict=True)
    
    received_qty = {}
    for entry in already_received_qty:
        # Using flt() here as a safety net
        received_qty[entry.po_row_name] =  frappe.utils.flt(entry.qty)
            
    for row in po_doc.items:
        # FIX: .get(key, 0) returns 0 if the key is missing
        # FIX: flt() handles None safely unlike float()
        prev_qty = received_qty.get(row.name, 0)
        remaining_qty = frappe.utils.flt(row.qty) -  frappe.utils.flt(prev_qty)
        
        if remaining_qty <= 0:
            continue
            
        pr_data["items"].append({
            "item": row.item,
            "name1": row.name1,
            "test_po": po_doc.name,
            "qty": remaining_qty,
            "po_row_name": row.name
        })
    
    frappe.response["message"] = pr_data

name: on_submit Customer Feedback
script:
if doc.feedback_text:
    account_manager = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "account_manager")
    
    todo_doc = frappe.new_doc("ToDo")
    todo_doc.description = "Review Feedback -" + str(doc.customer)
    todo_doc.reference_type = doc.doctype
    todo_doc.reference_name = doc.name
    todo_doc.status = "Open"
    todo_doc.priority = "Medium"
    todo_doc.owner = account_manager
    
    todo_doc.insert()
